# The Shopper's Verdict — Full Site Guide

> We read thousands of Amazon customer reviews so you don't have to. The Shopper's Verdict delivers unbiased, data-driven product verdicts across 10+ shopping categories. Each review aggregates real Amazon customer feedback — the good, the bad, and the "broke after 6 months" — and distills it into clear, actionable buying decisions.

## About This Site

**URL:** https://theshoppersverdict.com
**Published by:** GLYC Digital
**Launched:** 2026
**Total reviews:** ~28,000+
**Review methodology:** We analyze all customer reviews on Amazon for each product, identify recurring themes (pros, cons, quality issues), and present a balanced verdict with pros/cons lists, aggregate rating, review count, price, and FAQ. We do not accept sponsored reviews or paid placements.

**Affiliate model:** We use Amazon affiliate links (tag: tsvglyc-20). This means we earn a small commission if readers purchase through our links. Our verdicts are based on real customer reviews, not affiliate commissions.

**Content structure:** Every review page includes:
- Verdict score (1-5 scale based on our analysis)
- Amazon aggregate rating and review count
- Product price in USD
- Amazon product image
- Pros and cons lists extracted from customer reviews
- Detailed review body analyzing product strengths and weaknesses
- FAQ section answering common buyer questions
- Affiliate "Check Price on Amazon" button
- JSON-LD structured data for WebSite, BreadcrumbList, Article, Product (with AggregateRating and Offer), and FAQPage

### Kitchen Appliances
https://theshoppersverdict.com/kitchen/
Air fryers, cookware sets, blenders, coffee makers, kitchen gadgets, food storage, knives, bakeware, countertop appliances, and more. Our largest category with thousands of reviews.

**Top picks:**
- Commercial Blender 2200W with Soundproof Cover — 5.0/5. High-power blending for smoothies, soups, and frozen drinks. Sound-dampening enclosure reduces noise significantly.

- Zyliss Susi 3 Garlic Press — 4.6/5. Built-in cleaning tool, ergonomic design, stainless steel mechanism.
- Bella 4Qt Slim Air Fryer Seaglass — Compact design, vibrant color options, good value for solo/small households.

## Site Features

**SEO & Structured Data:**
- All pages include Open Graph, Twitter Cards, and canonical URLs
- JSON-LD structured data on every page: WebSite, BreadcrumbList, Article (reviews), Product with AggregateRating and Offer, FAQPage
- Auto-generated XML sitemap submitted via robots.txt
- Clean URL slugs per category (e.g., /coffee/product-name-review/)

**Analytics:**
- Privacy-focused Umami analytics (self-hosted)
- Affiliate click tracking via custom events

**Technical:**
- Built with Hugo static site generator (v0.161+)
- Hosted on Cloudflare Pages (Pro plan)
- Source on GitHub: github.com/GLYCdigital/theshoppersverdict
- Approximately 56,000 HTML pages deployed
- Minified HTML, CSS served in-bundle

## Content Policy

All reviews at The Shopper's Verdict are based on analysis of existing Amazon customer reviews. We do not purchase or test products ourselves. Our verdicts represent a synthesis of hundreds to thousands of individual customer experiences. We aim for balanced, useful summaries that help shoppers make informed decisions.
